beta_new: Easy moves, only 5.10 in difficulty, take you beyond a bolt and through a low roof with a second bolt. Past the lip comes a powerful sequence with four more bolts before the anchors.

beta_new: The route leaves a small crack-and-corner, heads rightward across the opening bolts, then swings back left over the roof of jugs to the anchors.
Start up the corner at the orange wall's right, pass three bolts, then get over the roof at its right-hand end, clipping a bolt, and head for the top.
Start on a ledge beside a corner, pass a roof, and follow the striped wall to the anchors.
The first pitch ascends the sloping buttress to anchors beneath the roof's right end. The second cranks across the roof by way of fixed pins and pulls over.
Step off the small boulder, work rightward past the first two bolts, then head directly up the wall and finish through the high roof.

Reach the route by taking Old Man's Route's first pitch to a big shelf with a pine, then anchor yourself to a tree beside twin cracks. The first pitch follows the cracks to a stance beneath a huge two-tiered overhang; the second follows them across the overhangs and then a corner angled left, finishing rightward at a pine.
Start at a short corner facing left, near a low roof, and climb the spotless white wall to the anchors.
Follow Burning Cross up to its sixth bolt, then step left and finish by clipping a single extra bolt on the way to the Skull Poke anchors.
Follow the start of the neighboring overhang route until beneath the big ceiling, then shift right and continue up. A fixed pin at the crux gives protection.
